title: Barrier Island Aviation Ltd
specs: See dolphins, sea turtles, shipwrecks, the Wright Brothers’ Monument, Bodie Island Lighthouse, and other popular attractions from the air.
Plane has capacity for up to 3 guests. Combined weight cannot exceed 575 lbs.
For your safety, our plane can only hold up to 575 lbs of combined weight.

services.desc: North of KDH the down the coast to Oregon Inlet. See Manteo, Jockeys Ridge, Wright Brothers Monument, Coastline, Shipwrecks, Bodie Island Lighthouse, Oregon

services.name: Cessna 172 Air Tour | 60 Minutes
services.desc: North of Duck then down the coast to Rodanthe. See Manteo, Jockeys Ridge, Wright Brothers Monument, Coastline, Shipwrecks, Bodie Island Lighthouse, Oregon Inlet, Pea Island Wildlife

blurb: Guests soar over the Outer Banks in a 1942 open-cockpit biplane or a Cessna 172. They see dolphins, sea turtles, shipwrecks, the Wright Brothers’ Monument, Bodie Island Lighthouse, and other popular attractions from the air. Tours depart from Dare County Regional Airport in Manteo, NC.
extraNote: Dare County Regional Airport in Manteo, just past the NC Aquarium on Airport Road. Turn left once you enter the airport parking lot and look for the big tan hangar.
